# Public Value Metrics

> A comprehensive introduction to public value math, examples, and reasoning, written for software engineers building for governmental and social sector organizations worldwide. Each file covers one metric or concept: definition, why it matters, the method, a worked example, the software engineering connection, pitfalls, and sources.

64 topics in 8 parts, published in 52 locales. Canonical locale: `en-gb-oxendict` (English, Oxford spelling); the other locales are AI-translated. Each topic page covers: definition, why it matters, the maths, a worked example, the software engineering connection, pitfalls, sources.

Topic URLs follow `https://public-value-metrics.github.io/<locale>/topics/<slug>/`. Slugs are English in the English locales and translated in every other locale; `/<locale>/topics/` lists a locale's slugs. Source and conventions: https://github.com/public-value-metrics/public-value-metrics (see AGENTS.md).

## Public value foundations

- [Public value](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/public-value/): Mark Moore's strategic triangle: legitimacy, mission, and operational capacity as the test of public worth
- [Value for money (VFM)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/value-for-money/): Economy, efficiency, effectiveness — and the contested fourth E, equity
- [Opportunity cost in public spending](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/opportunity-cost-in-public-spending/): Every pound a department spends is a pound not spent on the next-best programme
- [Social discount rate](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/social-discount-rate/): The Green Book's declining discount rate, and why 3.5% became a live political question
- [Distributional weighting](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/distributional-weighting/): Why a pound matters more to a poor household — and how the Green Book prices that
- [Additionality and deadweight](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/additionality-and-deadweight/): Would it have happened anyway? The question that deflates most impact claims
- [Displacement and attribution](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/displacement-and-attribution/): When your win is someone else's loss, and when it isn't fully yours to claim
- [Counterfactual analysis](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/counterfactual-analysis/): No counterfactual, no evidence — constructing the world without the intervention

## Governmental economic appraisal

- [Green Book appraisal (five-case model)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/green-book-appraisal/): HM Treasury's five-case model: the strategic, economic, commercial, financial, and management cases
- [Social cost-benefit analysis (SCBA)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/social-cost-benefit-analysis/): Monetising everything, including what markets never priced
- [Cost-effectiveness analysis in government](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/cost-effectiveness-analysis-in-government/): Cost per unit of outcome, when outcomes can't honestly be converted to money
- [Multi-criteria decision analysis (MCDA)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/multi-criteria-decision-analysis/): Scoring options against weighted criteria when a single metric would hide the trade-offs
- [Wellbeing valuation (WELLBY)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/wellbeing-valuation/): WELLBYs and the wellbeing adjustment: pricing policy in life-satisfaction units
- [Stated preference valuation](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/stated-preference-valuation/): Asking people what they'd pay — contingent valuation and its credibility problem
- [Revealed preference valuation](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/revealed-preference-valuation/): Inferring value from what people actually do, from hedonic pricing to travel-cost methods
- [Shadow pricing](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/shadow-pricing/): Pricing what has no market price: carbon, time, and non-traded goods

## Social value and impact measurement

- [Social return on investment (SROI)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/social-return-on-investment/): The SROI ratio, and the discipline that keeps it from becoming a marketing number
- [Theory of change](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/theory-of-change/): Mapping the causal chain from activity to long-term outcome before you measure anything
- [Logic model](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/logic-model/): Inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes, impact — the accountability spine of a programme
- [Outcomes vs outputs](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/outcomes-vs-outputs/): Why "500 people attended" is not the same claim as "500 people's lives improved"
- [Social Value Act](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/social-value-act/): The UK's 2012 duty to consider social value in public procurement
- [Unit cost databases](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/unit-cost-databases/): HACT's Social Value Bank and Global Value Exchange: pre-costed proxies so nobody starts from zero
- [Impact evaluation methods](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/impact-evaluation-methods/): RCTs, difference-in-differences, and propensity score matching for policies you can't run in a lab
- [Impact evaluation vs process evaluation](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/impact-evaluation-vs-process-evaluation/): Did it work, versus did it happen as designed — two different questions, two different methods

## Governmental performance and delivery metrics

- [Public sector KPIs](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/public-sector-kpis/): Choosing indicators that survive Goodhart's law
- [Public value scorecard](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/public-value-scorecard/): Adapting Kaplan and Norton's balanced scorecard for a mission that isn't profit
- [Outcomes-based accountability](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/outcomes-based-accountability/): Mark Friedman's "Results-Based Accountability": population results versus performance accountability
- [Payment by results and social impact bonds](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/payment-by-results-and-social-impact-bonds/): Paying for outcomes, not activity — and why the incentive design is the whole game
- [Public service productivity](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/public-service-productivity/): Measuring output growth in services with no market price, from the ONS methodology onward
- [Citizen satisfaction metrics](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/citizen-satisfaction-metrics/): Net satisfaction, trust surveys, and the gap between service quality and perceived value
- [Service standards and transaction metrics](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/service-standards-and-transaction-metrics/): GOV.UK-style service standards: completion rate, cost per transaction, digital take-up
- [Trust and legitimacy metrics](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/trust-and-legitimacy-metrics/): Why legitimacy is one of Moore's three tests, and how governments try to measure it

## Social sector and philanthropy metrics

- [Cost per outcome](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/cost-per-outcome/): The unit economics of a charity: cost per person meaningfully helped, not cost per person touched
- [Cost per beneficiary](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/cost-per-beneficiary/): A cruder, faster cousin of cost-per-outcome, and why funders still ask for it
- [Blended value](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/blended-value/): Financial, social, and environmental return as one inseparable bottom line
- [Effective altruism cost-effectiveness](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/effective-altruism-cost-effectiveness/): GiveWell-style cost-per-life-saved reasoning, and its QALY-shaped ancestry
- [Charity overhead ratio](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/charity-overhead-ratio/): Why the "how much goes to admin" question is the wrong question, and funders still ask it
- [Donor return on investment](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/donor-return-on-investment/): What a donor actually gets back, and why it isn't the charity's ROI
- [Grant outcomes reporting (IRIS+)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/grant-outcomes-reporting/): IRIS+ metrics and the standardisation of what funders ask grantees to report
- [Volunteer time value](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/volunteer-time-value/): Pricing unpaid labour without either erasing it or inflating it

## Public value in digital government

- [Digital service standard](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/digital-service-standard/): GOV.UK's design principles and service assessment as a public value gate
- [Cost per transaction](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/cost-per-transaction/): The digital channel's headline economics, and its most common accounting trick
- [Channel shift savings](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/channel-shift-savings/): What actually happens to the phone line and the counter when a service goes online
- [Digital inclusion](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/digital-inclusion/): Assisted digital, the digital divide, and the value lost when "digital by default" excludes
- [Government as a platform](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/government-as-a-platform/): Shared components as public infrastructure: GOV.UK Notify, Pay, and the economics of reuse
- [Open data value](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/open-data-value/): Valuing data that has no price, from the McKinsey estimates to per-dataset case studies
- [Public sector cybersecurity value](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/public-sector-cybersecurity-value/): Pricing risk reduction for the citizen data a breach would expose
- [AI in government value](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/ai-in-government-value/): Assessing AI adoption in public services against the same value-for-money bar as everything else

## Wellbeing, equity and societal indicators

- [GDP alternatives](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/gdp-alternatives/): The Genuine Progress Indicator, Gross National Happiness, and GDP's well-known blind spots
- [Human Development Index (HDI)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/human-development-index/): Life expectancy, education, and income combined into one number — and what it flattens
- [Multidimensional Poverty Index (MPI)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/multidimensional-poverty-index/): Counting deprivations, not just income, across health, education, and living standards
- [Wellbeing-adjusted life years (WELLBY)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/wellbeing-adjusted-life-years/): The WELLBY: a QALY-shaped unit for policies whose currency is life satisfaction, not health
- [Index of Multiple Deprivation (IMD)](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/index-of-multiple-deprivation/): England's small-area deprivation ranking, and how it routes funding and attention
- [Social capital metrics](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/social-capital-metrics/): Trust, networks, and civic participation as an economic asset with no ledger entry
- [Natural capital accounting](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/natural-capital-accounting/): Putting the environment on the balance sheet, from the UK's 25 Year Environment Plan onward
- [Intergenerational equity and sustainability discounting](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/intergenerational-equity-and-sustainability-discounting/): Why discounting the far future at any positive rate can erase it from the analysis

## Software engineering and digital delivery connection

- [Cost of delay in public programmes](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/cost-of-delay-in-public-programmes/): £/week or WELLBYs/week of non-delivery — the master bridge metric, imported from health economics
- [DORA metrics for public value](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/dora-metrics-for-public-value/): Delivery performance metrics, translated into public-sector accountability terms
- [Flow metrics in government delivery](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/flow-metrics-in-government-delivery/): Little's Law, WIP, and flow efficiency applied to a casework queue instead of a sprint board
- [Technical debt as public value erosion](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/technical-debt-as-public-value-erosion/): Principal and interest, and the chronic-disease economics of a legacy public system
- [Total cost of ownership (TCO) in government IT](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/total-cost-of-ownership-in-government-it/): Maintenance is 50-80% of the bill; the naive-procurement-price error in public IT
- [Build vs buy in government](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/build-vs-buy-in-government/): Risk-adjusted comparison with the delay term priced, for a sector that mostly buys
- [Benefits realization](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/benefits-realization/): Auditing that the business case's forecast benefits actually landed, after go-live
- [AI productivity in the public sector](https://public-value-metrics.github.io/en-gb-oxendict/topics/ai-productivity-in-the-public-sector/): What the AI-developer-productivity evidence base implies for public-sector engineering teams
